fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our annual fuel consumption, a hypothetical 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased into-plane aircraft fuel cost for 2016 by $44.8 million. As of December 31, 2016 and 2015, we did not have any outstanding fuel derivatives.

instrument_type_details.notes: No outstanding fuel derivatives as of Dec 31, 2016. Company still describes hedging capabilities (jet fuel swaps and options).

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed 302,781 [2016] 255,008 [2015] [from 2016 Annual Report operating statistics table, in thousands]; Aircraft fuel expense decreased by 3.0% from $461.4 million in 2015 to $447.6 million in 2016 due to 18.7% increase in fuel gallons consumed.
